Macrons

Consonantal i

Conversation, family & daily routines

in a low voice phrase

also quietly, whisper

classical

summissā vōce

Examples

  • Pater digitō silentium suāsit. Theodōrus, quī alibī clāmāre solet, hīc vōce summissā «Pluteī sunt, tata,» inquit, «sīcut avī, sed aurātī.»

    Dad put a finger to his lips. Theo, who shouts everywhere else, said here in a low voice, “They’re bookshelves, Dad, like Grandpa’s, but golden.”Libellus III, Apud avum et aviam

Other words

  • vōce summissā

    also used · classical

See also put a finger to one’s lips, on tiptoe, lower your voice.
